scientific_integrity: The proof gives exact Taylor coefficients, local concavity, transverse spectral bounds and an implicit-function argument for full-torus local completeness; finite numerical checks only corroborate examples; earlier period-two results are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Local prime-four creation at one finite parameter on every finite unweighted Huygens star; no global four-cycle census, uniform leaf-number neighborhood, general weighted graph stability, or independent priority audit.
title: Simultaneous supercritical period-four births and full-network attraction in Huygens stars
